notes:
### RuForge 0.5.0

- **Library**: A YouTube-style home with your feed, channel shelves and creator pages.
- **Follow**: Follow channels, get new uploads in a notification center, and auto-download them if you like.
- **Music**: Playlists, YouTube Music recommendations with previews, one search bar, and import from screenshots.
- **Island**: Downloads and notices show at the top of your screen while RuForge is in the background.
- **Downloads**: Playlists list in seconds, storage is checked before a download starts, and errors say what to fix.
- **Fixes**: Steadier playback, downloads that clean up after themselves, and yt-dlp and ffmpeg that close with RuForge.
additions: Library: The video library home is laid out like YouTube, with Continue watching, Shorts shelves, your playlists, "More from" channel rows, and your YouTube home feed mixed in so you can preview any video and download it in one click
Library: Click a creator's name or avatar to open their page, with Home, Videos, Downloaded and Playlists tabs, Follow, and Open in YouTube
Follow: Follow YouTube channels from Explorer, the library or a pasted link, see their new uploads and premieres, and choose to auto-download them
Notifications: A notification center behind the title bar bell collects new uploads and download results with one-click actions, in every mode

Island: While RuForge is in the background, downloads and notices show in an island at the top of the screen you are using; inside the app, download progress sits in the title bar island and expands into a list
Music: Make playlists from the sidebar, the Library Playlists tab, Ctrl+N or Add to playlist, then rename, reorder, fill them from a library search, and drag songs onto them
Music: Playlists save to a file so they survive a cleared cache, follow songs you move, take a description, and export or import as .m3u8

Music: Recommended under a playlist suggests YouTube Music songs you don't own yet, mixed from three radios with at most two per artist; preview any for 15 seconds from its most replayed part, Add downloads it with two similar songs beside it, and hide a song or artist for good
Music: Import a playlist from screenshots through any chatbot, review and preview each match, pick up an unfinished import after a restart, and add to an existing playlist by saving under its name
Music: One search bar shows matching songs, playlists, albums and artists from your library as you type, plus recent searches, and searches YouTube Music when nothing in your library matches
Music: About the artist opens a sheet with a Wikipedia bio, photos, your plays and top tracks, and links to their socials
Music: Right-click a song and choose Delete song to move it to the Recycle Bin, with the same restore path as the video library
Music: The left nav and the right panel remember whether they were open and which tab you were on
Downloads: Playlist links list their videos in seconds, sizes fill in as you go, and you can drag videos to reorder them before downloading
Downloads: The queue checks free disk space and your library storage limit before a download starts, and flags rows that won't fit
Downloads: When YouTube's playback check fails, the error says whether yt-dlp is out of date or Deno is missing, with Install and Retry buttons, and installing Deno retries the failed downloads
Storage: Free internal space groups your downloads into Music, Videos and Livestreams, and the footer bar shows how much each type takes
Player: New keyboard shortcuts (C captions, M mute, K play/pause, arrows, speed, seek), Ctrl+D opens the paste-link downloader, and play, volume and captions show YouTube-style feedback in the center
Player: SponsorBlock auto-skips fast-forward visibly with an Unskip button, and new installs auto-skip sponsors, self-promo, interaction reminders, intros and outros
Explorer: A bottom bar shows which YouTube page you are on and lets you paste a link, reload, or copy the page URL
Notifications: Popups appear at the bottom center sized to their text, and a card in the downloader announces a newer yt-dlp and fills in as it updates
Library: The default grid fits four videos per row on wide windows
Settings: The export-to-drive title bar button is off by default; turn it back on in Settings > Export
Crash recovery: The crash screen opens the first app stack frame section by default
Installer: License texts for FFmpeg (GPLv3), yt-dlp and RuForge now install with a third-party notices file
Onboarding: A tip on the library home shows how to follow a creator and turn on auto-download
Onboarding: A tip on your first visit to Music walks through importing a playlist from screenshots
Onboarding: Every tip has a dismiss button, and a dismissed tip never comes back
fixes: Downloads: yt-dlp and ffmpeg now close with RuForge, even after a crash or force-kill, and lookups that time out no longer leave yt-dlp running
Downloads: Long audio downloads finish instead of timing out at two minutes, and an audio conversion stopped partway is removed instead of showing up as a song
Downloads: Cleanup after a download removes only that download's own leftovers, through the Recycle Bin, and the library no longer deletes look-alike files on launch
Downloads: When several music downloads finish back to back, each one is tagged as the right song
Downloads: Progress no longer jumps to 100% at the start when captions are saved with the video
Downloads: A queued download whose video info can't load after a restart shows as failed with the reason instead of sitting in the queue
Downloads: RuForge Internal cookies work right after launch without opening Explorer or Music Explore first
Music: Auto-save no longer re-downloads songs you cancelled or already saved, and no longer starts downloads you held elsewhere
Music: Listening stats survive crashes and damaged files, a song change no longer logs the same play twice, and older play counts are kept when stats rebuild
Music: Music mode stays smooth while a song plays, even on long playlists, and finishing a track no longer stalls on a big listening history
Music: Volume changes ramp smoothly instead of popping
Player: Videos resume about 10 seconds before where you left off again, and music starts fresh on each track
Player: Volume changes apply from the keyboard and slider, and reopening the same video resumes it
Player: Loop one stays on the current file and clears when you skip, in videos and in Music
Player: Scrub preview segment labels like Intro and Highlight use solid colors so they read clearly
Playback: Video plays at full frame rate on a monitor that isn't active
Comments: The panel sits above the control bar, its sort menu matches the player menus, and a short drag snaps it fully open or closed
Library: Files with uppercase extensions like .MP4 and .MKV now show up
Library: Hovering or scrolling past cards no longer adds empty space at the bottom or makes the page jump
Storage: Free internal space no longer lists a video twice when it is also in a playlist, so sorting and the selected size are right
Nav: The Alt radial menu opens on top of YouTube and YouTube Music pages instead of behind them
Privacy: The YouTube page inside Music can no longer read app events that carry your file paths or download details
Privacy: RuForge's own screens no longer stop to ask for microphone or clipboard access; YouTube pages still ask as usual
Onboarding: Finished tips stay finished after a restart, and the Discord tip completes on its own when Discord activity is already on
